recognize_zh: 十個嗜中性球（A–J）的分葉核因偶然的折疊與分葉形狀，分別像阿拉伯數字 0 到 9；細胞質有正常細小的淡紫色顆粒、染色質成熟，屬正常嗜中性球核形的變異，不代表病理。
features: Mature neutrophils with fine pink-lilac specific granules in abundant cytoplasm
Condensed, clumped mature chromatin in lobated or band-like nuclei
Nuclear contours folded or segmented into shapes resembling numerals 0 through 9 (panels A-J)
Normal number of lobes (mostly 2-4) without hypersegmentation, hypogranulation or pseudo-Pelger forms
describe_en: Composite of peripheral blood neutrophils shows mature cells with abundant cytoplasm containing fine specific granules and nuclei with condensed chromatin. The nuclear segments and bands are folded into configurations resembling the numerals 0 through 9. There is no hypersegmentation, hypogranulation, toxic change or bilobed pseudo-Pelger-Huet morphology. These are normal morphologic variants of neutrophil nuclear shape and carry no diagnostic significance.

ddx.vs: Pelger forms have bilobed spectacle-shaped or non-lobated nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin and often hypogranular cytoplasm, unlike these normally segmented, granulated cells.
Hypersegmentation requires six or more lobes or many five-lobed cells, whereas these nuclei have a normal number of segments.
Panel A resembles a ring, but true ring neutrophils have a continuous doughnut nucleus with a central hole in increased numbers.
